text: SUMMARY STAGE 0 In situ: noninvasive, intraepithelial

1 Localized only (localized, NOS)

- Confined to nasopharynx, NOS
- Invasive tumor confined to one of the following subsites

`o` Inferior wall (superior surface of soft palate) `o` Lateral wall `o` Posterior superior wall (vault)

- Involvement of two or more subsites
